title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E02 — Gone in a New York Minute
Landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006; though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they, along with Bruce's brother Ed, spend the next nine years searching for answers and a killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E05 — Vanished in Virginia
When 30-year-old mother Lisa Gaudenzi fails to report for duty in Virginia, the Army lists her as AWOL; her family immediately suspects foul play, so they embark on a 13-year quest for answers before an eyewitness blows the case wide open.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E01 — Killer in the Storm
In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but Brenda's older sister Linda vows to solve Brenda's murder, no matter how long it takes.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E04 — Death of a Hero
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E14 — No Known Enemies
When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Mich., wonder who would murder this pillar of the community; it will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E11 — Blood Red Snow
When Chris Green, 19, is found beaten to death in a snowy Bangor, Michigan, ditch in 2002, his family fears their son's murder will never be solved; years pass before shocking revelations from an informant emerge and blow the case wide open.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E06 — Taken in Tacoma
When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August 1986, residents of Tacoma, Wash., panic; convinced a predator is on the loose, police embark on a 32-year inquiry to catch the killer.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E01 — Danielle Redlick
Stay-at-home mom Danielle Redlick is charged with the murder of her husband, pro sports executive Michael Redlick; after holding onto her account for nearly three years, Danielle finally takes the witness stand and her story takes a turn.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E05 — Lynlee Renick
When Ben Renick is found dead in his snake facility, law enforcement assumes he is a victim of one of his snakes -- until the coroner finds bullet casings hidden behind shelves; three years of investigation eventually lead police to Ben's wife.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E02 — Adam Matos
When an entire family is found in a decaying pile of bodies by the side of a Florida road, the hunt is on to find what police fear might be two more victims; a man and his son are found alive, launching a bizarre investigation.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E07 — Joshua Aide
Joshua Aide is on trial for the murder of his ex-girlfriend's father, as well as her attempted murder and that of a family friend. He claims he was ambushed by the three who were plotting to kill him and cash in on his life insurance policy.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E06 — Cristhian Bahena Rivera
When a young college student disappears on her evening run, investigators scour her small town searching for her; when her accused attacker takes the stand, the story becomes more complicated than expected.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E03 — Nancy Brophy
Romance novelist Nancy Brophy faces life in prison for the murder of her husband; she is set to testify in her own defense and her attorneys launch a full-fledged effort to paint her as a creative.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E04 — Curtis Reeves
Curtis Reeves stands accused of murdering Chad Oulson over popcorn at a matinée movie; the defense claims he acted in self-defense while the state's prosecutors argue that Reeves was short-tempered and unjustified in the shooting.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E03 — All in the Family
The peaceful town of Mountain City, Tenn., is rocked when a beloved young couple are found brutally murdered in their home; as police search for their killer, they uncover a family enmeshed in sinister secrets and lies.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E09 — Dead End
A young, pregnant woman is found dead of an apparent suicide in Saginaw, Mich., but her family and friends don't believe it; as police dig deep to get to the truth, they discover a shocking secret they never saw coming.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E05 — The Girl Next Door
The community of Macon, Ga., is gripped in a wave of terror when a beautiful law student disappears from her apartment complex; the shocking discovery of a body leads investigators uncomfortably close to home.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E08 — Off the Grid
The family of a missing Texas mother becomes concerned when they start receiving suspicious text messages from her phone; a trail of digital clues helps investigators.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E06 — Game Over
Police in Mobile, Ala., quickly identify a suspect in the murder of a local college professor, but a bombshell piece of technology stolen from the crime scene then points them in a completely different direction.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E10 — Deadly Last Steps
After a young woman in South Carolina is found dead in her bathtub, the investigation focuses in on her estranged husband and her boyfriend; an unexpected digital clue has one of these persons of interest accidentally confessing to the murder.

title: Witness to Murder: Digital Evidence
description:
S01 E07 — Accidental Confession
A love triangle at the University of Florida results in the murder of a popular student; an undeniable digital trail leads straight to his murderer and helps authorities piece together the details of the crime and secure a conviction.

description:
S01 E01 — Happy Face Killer: Keith Hunter Jesperson
Melissa Moore, daughter of Keith Hunter Jesperson, tells her story as the daughter of a serial killer; Melissa meets a family member of one of her father's victims.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E03 — Phoenix Serial Shooter: Dale Hausner
Randy Hausner reveals how his brother terrorized the city of Phoenix in a killing spree; Randy meets with a shooting survivor and with the son of a man killed by his brother.
